{{Quote|Four of the Z-95s were destroyed with no survivors, though one Headhunter is unaccounted for, but is believed to have succumbed to the gravity well of nearby Vuchelle and burned up on reentry.|HoloNet News report|<ref name="HNN" />}}
The '''Vuchelle system''' lay in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]] and contained the astronomical object [[Vuchelle]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-led [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Task force/Legends|task force]] defeated the [[Iridium Pirates/Legends|pirates of Iridium]] in a [[Skirmish over Vuchelle|confrontation]] that took place in the [[Star system/Legends|system]]. It was later reported by the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] that one of the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates']] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] was believed to have [[Fire/Legends|burned]] up in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of Vuchelle.

==Description==
The Vuchelle [[Star system/Legends|system]] was a part of the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]] that was located in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Braxant Run/Legends|Braxant Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] linked it to the [[Fedje system/Legends|Fedje system]] and the [[Cassander sector/Legends|Cassander sector's]] [[Isiring system/Legends|Isiring system]].<ref name="TEA" /> The [[Star/Legends|star]] system contained the astronomical object [[Vuchelle]]. In addition, a large [[Color/Legends|green]]-and-yellow [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] could be seen from within the system.<ref name="HNN" />

==History==
{{Quote|Sensor reports from the Atrivis sector issued by the Judicial Department confirm that a Jedi task force has thrashed the space pirates of Iridium, bringing an end to their year-long raids along the Atrivis sector routes.|HoloNet News report|<ref name="HNN" />}}
By the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] [[22 BBY/Legends|13:3:28]], the [[Iridium Pirates/Legends|pirates of Iridium]] had been committing [[Standard year/Legends|year]]-long raids on [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Convoy/Legends|convoys]] along the Atrivis [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] routes,<ref name="HNN" /> including in the vicinity of Vuchelle.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|49|Hokken, Dovish}}</ref> A joint [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]&ndash;Republic [[Task force/Legends|task force]] attempted to conduct peaceful negotiations in the Vuchelle system with the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. During the talks, the raiders [[Skirmish over Vuchelle|opened fire]], leading to a confrontation that took place near Vuchelle.<ref name="HNN" />

Eventually, the pirate force was defeated, and it was later reported in an issue of the [[HoloNet News CoCo District Edition|CoCo District Edition]] of the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] that one of the raiders' [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] was believed to have succumbed to Vuchelle's [[Gravity well/Legends|gravity well]] and [[Fire/Legends|burned]] up in its [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]].<ref name="HNN" /> The Vuchelle system was situated in the territory of the [[Pentastar Alignment]] between [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] and [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]]<ref name="TEA" /> and fell within the borders of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] between 12 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]] and [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Vuchelle system was first depicted in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 49|''HoloNet News Vol. 531 #49'']], an [[in-universe]] issue of the HoloNet News<ref name="HNN" /> written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]], illustrated by [[Joe Corroney]],<ref name="Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref> and published on the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News website]] on [[March 28]], [[2002]].<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6217551|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=Dev Sibwarra|date=2002-03-28|time=4:24 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200305125429/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-holonetnews-discussion-thread.5990764/page-13}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], identified the system by name and placed it in grid square L-5.<ref name="TEA" />
